rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when depending on a person, resource, or system to provide support or make something possible.

example.english: This machine crashes all the time, so you can't rely on it for work.
example.traditional: 呢部機成日死機，唔可以靠佢做嘢。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gei1 seng4 jat6 sei2 gei1 m4 ho2 ji5 kaau3 keoi5 zou6 je5

rows.note: Use this when “rely” emphasizes trusting someone's honesty, judgment, or ability rather than depending on a resource.

example.english: I rely on you to handle this matter.
example.traditional: 我信你，呢單嘢交畀你處理。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seon3 nei5 ni1 daan1 je5 gaau1 bei2 nei5 cyu5 lei5
